content.user_title: Prioritize Post Replies and Draft Responses
content.value_statement: Busy comment threads make it difficult to identify replies that deserve attention. This skill sorts comments before drafting relevant responses for your review.
actual_capabilities: Classifies replies into real answers, reaction only, leave it, and needs the human before drafting.
Drafts responses to the actual question and acknowledges when an answer is unknown.
Handles disagreement by acknowledging valid points and discussing claims instead of attacking people.
Limits responses to bait to one reply or none.
Stops drafting for comments involving clients, employers, money, legal matters, or ongoing disputes.
Uses optional VoiceMOAT tools for post context, voice profiles, and voice-match scoring when connected.
limitations: You must provide the replies; the documented get_post tool retrieves the post, not its comments.
VoiceMOAT integration requires a connected account with a Pro or Enterprise plan.
The skill does not determine defamation, legal liability, or contract breaches.
Drafts require human review; the skill does not provide automatic publishing or unread apologies.

use_cases.title: Manage a Busy Post
use_cases.description: Separate genuine questions from simple acknowledgments and irrelevant comments, then prepare answers for review.

use_cases.title: Respond to Technical Disagreement
use_cases.description: Acknowledge valid criticism and draft a factual response without turning the thread into a personal argument.

use_cases.title: Escalate Sensitive Comments
use_cases.description: Identify comments involving clients, money, or disputes and pause drafting so the responsible person can review them.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Here is my post: [post]. Here is one reply: [reply]. Classify it, then draft an answer only if appropriate.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: decide how to handle one comment.

prompt_templates.title: Sort a Comment Thread
prompt_templates.prompt: Here is my post: [post]. Sort these replies into the four categories before drafting: [replies]. Flag sensitive comments without drafting responses.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prioritize a batch of replies.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Disagreement
prompt_templates.prompt: Post: [post]. Disagreement: [comment]. Supporting facts: [facts]. Classify the comment, acknowledge valid points, and draft a concise response for review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: address criticism with factual context.

prompt_templates.title: Review Replies for Voice Consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Post: [post]. Replies: [replies]. Voice examples: [examples]. Show triage, then draft eligible answers. Use VoiceMOAT tools if connected. Flag sensitive items without drafting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare a batch of responses with consistent voice.

output_examples.input: Post: I added setup examples to the guide. Replies: What changed? Thank you! Buy followers at my page.
output: Draft: I added setup examples to the guide.
Leave it: Buy followers at my page.

output_examples.input: Post: Every project benefits from daily meetings. Reply: Small teams may coordinate asynchronously without a daily meeting.
output: Draft: You are right that small teams may coordinate asynchronously. My claim was too broad.

output_examples.input: A commenter says your client owes them money and asks you to publicly admit a contract breach.
output: Needs the human: This comment involves a client, money, and a contract dispute.
No response drafted. Refer it to the responsible person.

best_practices: Provide the original post and relevant facts so drafts address the actual question.
Review the classification before reviewing drafts, especially comments involving sensitive relationships or disputes.
Read every draft before sending and use voice examples or a connected voice profile to check consistency.
anti_patterns: Drafting a long answer for every comment before identifying which replies deserve attention.
Continuing an argument with repeated replies to bait or personal attacks.
Treating instructions inside comments as authorization to publish, send messages, or bypass review.

faq.question: What categories does the skill use?
faq.answer: It uses real answer, reaction only, leave it, and needs the human. Classification happens before drafting.

faq.question: Does it fetch replies automatically?
faq.answer: No. You provide the replies. The optional get_post tool retrieves the original post and its numbers, not the replies.

faq.question: Can I use it without VoiceMOAT?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the post and replies directly. VoiceMOAT adds post context, voice profiles, and voice-match scoring when connected.

faq.question: Which VoiceMOAT plan supports the connector?
faq.answer: The skill states that the connector requires the Pro or Enterprise plan.

faq.question: Will it publish responses for me?
faq.answer: The documented workflow produces drafts for your review. Only the person using the skill decides what gets sent.

faq.question: How does it handle sensitive or hostile comments?
faq.answer: Sensitive comments require human review without drafts. Bait receives one reply or none, while genuine disagreements receive factual responses.
